policy: Capability-level donor decisions only; no copied production code is present at this baseline.

knownIssues: It is a numbering authority, not an input-selection or country-selector engine.
Metadata variants intentionally provide different validation precision.
The phone plugin must not become the package numbering authority.
IME, Android predictive input, controlled reconciliation, and browser parity still require local proof.
The mature caret behavior is coupled to donor-specific component and formatting assumptions.
Any internal adaptation must preserve attribution and be selected only after the shared browser bake-off.
The global utils-script integration used by Christofle is not server-safe and is rejected.
Its country UI and formatting behavior are reference inputs, not authority for this package.
The package must preserve MUI theme augmentation, utility-class, slot, and ownerState conventions rather than wrap them behind opaque props.
Portal and mobile-dialog behavior require explicit accessibility calibration.
APG examples are normative interaction references, not drop-in production components.
VoiceOver portal behavior and mobile full-screen presentation require product-specific proof.
Country data and phone semantics cannot be imported as an alternative authority.
Useful composition and mask ideas must be revalidated against MUI and libphonenumber-js contracts.
Its public callback and validation semantics are not adopted wholesale.
The component is a MUI ergonomics reference, not the selected input engine.
Bundled country tables and hand-maintained masks conflict with the single-authority rule.
Legacy DOM behavior is not suitable as the package core.
The adapter pattern is shallow and does not expose a modern MUI theme/slot contract.
It inherits react-phone-input-2 authority and behavior constraints.
Generic mask engines do not provide phone numbering authority or country resolution.
Display-mask mapping ideas are useful only after canonical-value invariants are protected.
Flags are decorative/identification assets and must never imply a country for non-geographic numbers.
External asset loading is rejected by default for privacy and reliability.
The package is useful for public naming and ergonomics comparison but does not satisfy the required engine, server, selector, or numbering-plan model.
No code is copied from this donor.

donors.license: Internal commercial code; pattern inspection only
inspectedTests: No dedicated phone-input test suite found at the inspected checkout
Replacement scenarios are captured in tests/corpus/christofle.ts
knownIssues: Account PhoneField injects /utils.min.js and directly mutates value and selection.
Checkout PhoneFieldCountry uses a separate manual COUNTRIES table and duplicated phone semantics.
The inspected checkout had unrelated dirty files; no Christofle file was modified.

capabilities.name: Parsing, numbering plans, possibility, validity, and number type
knownIssues: UI state must distinguish selected, detected, resolved, and possible countries without inventing country data.
capabilities.reason: Use the public library API as the sole phone authority and build package state around its outputs.
capabilities.licenseAction: Retain libphonenumber-js in runtime dependencies and include MIT attribution in third-party notices.

capabilities.name: DOM input transaction, selection, composition, and controlled reconciliation
knownIssues: Neither candidate is accepted until the same real-browser corpus passes in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.
capabilities.reason: Run two production-shaped candidates behind one adapter contract, then select by evidence in mpi-oan.22.
capabilities.licenseAction: Maskito candidate may depend on Apache-2.0 packages; donor adaptation must preserve MIT attribution and source notes if react-phone-number-input behavior is ported.

capabilities.name: Searchable accessible country selector
knownIssues: Desktop portal, mobile dialog, no-portal VoiceOver mode, and preferred-country ordering need separate proof.
capabilities.reason: Compose MUI primitives with APG keyboard semantics while deriving country data from libphonenumber-js and package locales.
capabilities.licenseAction: No APG example code or donor country tables are copied; cite APG and donor revisions in design documentation.

capabilities.name: MUI theme augmentation, slots, utility classes, ownerState, and composable primitives
knownIssues: Opaque wrappers and overlapping boolean props would prevent theme-level composition.
capabilities.reason: Follow MUI component conventions directly and use other phone inputs only to compare ergonomic naming.
capabilities.licenseAction: Use public APIs and naming analysis only; no donor component source copied.

capabilities.name: As-you-type formatting and declarative/advanced display masks
knownIssues: A display mask must never become a validation rule or mutate the canonical PhoneValue.
capabilities.reason: Use libphonenumber-js formatting as baseline and borrow only positional-mapping concepts for custom strategies.
capabilities.licenseAction: Document conceptual references; copy no IMask or react-international-phone implementation.

capabilities.name: Local and opt-in external flag rendering
knownIssues: Non-geographic numbers must not receive a false flag and external assets must remain opt-in.
capabilities.reason: Provide local flag entrypoints or user-supplied renderers while preserving privacy defaults.
capabilities.licenseAction: If local SVG assets are included, preserve country-flag-icons MIT attribution and asset provenance.

capabilities.name: Manual country/calling-code tables
knownIssues: Manual tables drift, duplicate numbering semantics, and cause premature shared-code country selection.
capabilities.reason: All country/calling-code and numbering-plan data must come from libphonenumber-js metadata.
capabilities.licenseAction: No table data or implementation copied.

capabilities.name: Direct input value/caret mutation and global utilities scripts
knownIssues: Direct mutation bypasses React controlled state, makes IME/autofill brittle, and is not server-safe.
capabilities.reason: Replace with the selected Input Transaction engine and neutral server APIs.

capabilities.name: Christofle account and checkout UX parity
knownIssues: Two independent families must converge without losing address-country synchronization, placeholder examples, modal behavior, or unified-field polish.
capabilities.reason: Retain product-facing behavior through MUI theme/slots while deleting duplicated phone authority during the gated Christofle integration phase.
capabilities.licenseAction: Internal code is inspected only; implementation remains independently authored in the public package.
